about_the_game:
Mystic Archipelago is an idle RPG where your party automatically battles through dungeons while you watch them grow stronger. Set in mystical islands, your heroes fight through forests and caves without requiring constant input.

Core Features:

  • Fully automated combat with intelligent AI decision-making

  • 10-battle dungeon sequences that run independently

  • Automatic healing and progression between fights

  • 20 unique enemies across two zones: Mystical Forest and Dark Caves

  • Boss battles, including Forest Dragon and Ancient Lich

Character Progression:

  • Party-based combat with multiple heroes

  • Equipment shop for upgrading gear

  • Stat enhancement system for permanent improvements

  • Classic RPG mechanics with HP, MP, and combat abilities

Interface:

  • Keyboard-only controls for streamlined navigation

  • Clean menu system designed for idle gameplay

  • Minimal interaction is required once dungeons begin

Built on RPG Maker MZ, this idle RPG offers progression-focused gameplay for players who enjoy watching their party develop over time. Perfect for multitasking or relaxed gaming sessions where the adventure continues automatically.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Built-in audio
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 Catalina
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card or Apple M1
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Built-in audio

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9.0c compatible
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:

  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
